'''Ann-Christine Albertsson''' is a Swedish chemist, currently Professor at [[Royal Institute of Technology]] and the Editor-in-Chief of [[American Chemical Society]]'s ''[[Biomacromolecules]]''.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.icbp2017tw.net/uploads/7/9/1/2/79129234/1._2017_icbp_photo_self_introduction_abbreviated_cv__under_3_pages_-_ann-christine_albertsson_.pdf |title=CV |publisher=icbp2017tw.net |accessdate=November 27, 2017 |archive-date=September 25, 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210925191444/https://www.icbp2017tw.net/uploads/7/9/1/2/79129234/1._2017_icbp_photo_self_introduction_abbreviated_cv__under_3_pages_-_ann-christine_albertsson_.pdf |url-status=dead }}</ref> Her research interest are biomacromolecules and polymers.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.kth.se/en/che/divisions/polymer-technology/staff/2.35079/ann-christine-albertsson-professor-1.19627 |title=Professor |publisher=kth.se |accessdate=November 27, 2017 |archive-date=December 1, 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171201031820/https://www.kth.se/en/che/divisions/polymer-technology/staff/2.35079/ann-christine-albertsson-professor-1.19627 |url-status=dead }}</ref>

==Education==
She earned her Doctorate from Royal Institute of Technology in 1977.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.kth.se/polopoly_fs/1.200466!/Menu/general/column-content/attachment/CV%20ACA%20111014.pdf |title=CV |publisher=kth.se |accessdate=November 27, 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130903205311/http://www.kth.se/polopoly_fs/1.200466!/Menu/general/column-content/attachment/CV%20ACA%20111014.pdf |archive-date=September 3, 2013 |url-status=dead }}</ref>

==Career==
She started as a lecturer at Royal Institute of Technology in 1980 before serving as acting professor in 1986 until being official appointed as professor in 1989. She has also been visiting scholar at [[Polytechnic University of New York]], [[University of Kyoto]], [[University of Massachusetts at Amherst]] and [[Research Institute for Polymers and Textiles]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://pubs.acs.org/page/bomaf6/profile.html |title=Editor |publisher=acs.org |accessdate=November 27, 2017}}</ref>

==Selected publications==
* Recent developments in ring opening polymerization of lactones for biomedical applications, AC Albertsson, IK Varma - Biomacromolecules, 2003, ACS Publications
* The mechanism of biodegradation of polyethylene, Polymer Degradation and Stability, Volume 18, Issue 1, 1987, Pages 73–87.
